item.description: The Flask route_wrapper function incorrectly applies the httpdbg hook by passing the wrapped function to Flask's native route decorator, which causes Flask to attempt to register the same function twice in its internal endpoint mapping, resulting in "View function mapping is overwriting an existing endpoint function" error.
item.contract: The route_wrapper must allow Flask's native route registration to proceed with the original function while ensuring httpdbg hooks are properly applied to the execution flow without interfering with Flask's internal endpoint management.
